zh: 只需要知道每个数在十进制下有几位，注意 0 也算 1 位。
位数可以直接取十进制字符串的长度，也可以反复除以 10 来数（这时 0 要单独当作 1 位处理）。
遍历数组，位数为偶数就把计数加一，最后输出计数。
en: You only need the number of decimal digits of each value; note that 0 has one digit.
The digit count is the length of the decimal string, or you can count divisions by 10 (in that case treat 0 as one digit separately).
Go through the array, add one to the count whenever the number of digits is even, and print the count.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the number of decimal digits of each non-negative integer, and count it if the number of digits is even. The number of digits can be obtained from the length of the decimal string; 0 is written with one digit.

## Correctness

Each array element contributes 1 only when its decimal representation has an even length, and 0 otherwise. Adding the contributions term by term gives exactly what the problem asks for, and each term is processed exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(n·d), where d≤10; space O(1) (excluding the space needed to parse the input).
